spans.s:
शृङ्खल (लः-ला-लं)
m. f. n. A belt; a chain; fetter.

शृङ्खलक (कः) 1.
m. A young camel
with clogs on his feet.

शृङ्खलित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Chained, fettered.

शृङ्ग (ङ्गं) 1.
n. A horn; a mark; a
peak; elevation, dignity; artifi-
cial fountain; lotus; very sharp
or fine.
m. Name of a sage.
f.
(ई) A fish and a plant; gold.

शृङ्गक (कः) 1.
m. A medicinal root,
Jivaka.

शृङ्गला (ला) 1.
f. A plant so named.

शृङ्गवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Horned,
peaked.

शृङ्ग-वेर (रं) 1.
n. Ginger.

शृङ्गाट (टं) 1.
n. Place where four
roads meet.
m. An aquatic plant;
a shrub.

शृङ्गाटक (कं) 1.
n. Idem; a door,
m. Mountain of three peaks.

शृङ्गार (रः) 1.
m. Love; copulation;
ornamental marks on the ele-
phant's head.
n. Cloves, red-
lead; a fragrant powder; gin-
ger;
Agallochum.

शृङ्गारक (कः-का-कं)
a. Horned or crested.

शृङ्गार-भूषण (णं) 1.
n. Red lead.

शृङ्गार-योनि (निः) 2.
m. Kāma.

शृङ्गारित (तः-ता-तं) Reddened; im-
passioned.

शृङ्गारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
m. The betel
nut tree; ardent lover; ele-
phant; dress, decoration.
a.
Painted red, feeling love.

शृङ्गि (ङ्गिः) 2.
f. A sort of sheat fish
m. n. Gold for ornaments.

शृङ्गिक (कं) 1.
n. A sort of poison;
a plant,
Betula.

शृङ्गि-कनक (कं) 1.
n. Gold for ornaments.

शृङ्गिण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Horned.
m. A
ram.

शृङ्गिन् (ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1.
m. An ele-
phant; mountain; tree.
f. (ई)
A cow; Arabian jasmine; heart
pea.
a. Horned, crested.
